decisions.label: Big packs: quicker from (animals)
decisions.note: Ed, 3 November: "how about we have the attack round length decrease gradually as the pack gets larger". A team (every wild animal on one target) of this many or fewer keeps today's rounds (5 s, a 3 s attack window); bigger, its round time, attack window and least rest shrink by (this / its size) ^ strength, never under the floor. 20 by default.

decisions.label: Big packs: how much quicker
decisions.note: The curve's power: 0.5 by default (one over the square root of the size over the reference: four times the reference, half the round; 64 animals 2.8 s rounds). 0 turns it off; 1 makes the round shrink in proportion to the size.

decisions.label: Big packs: shortest round (× today's)
decisions.note: The least share of today's round a big pack gets, so it never gets frantic: 0.4 by default (a 2 s round and a 1.2 s attack window, from 125 animals on). Her dodge token is unchanged: still one creature winding up or striking at her at once.
